pages.title: Levels
pages.text: A familiar grows with what it kills, and with a quarter of what I kill, up to level 20. Treats made at the altar feed it: a sculk morsel, an echo heart, a void delicacy.$(br2)At levels 5, 10, 15 and 20 it learns a trait and a move, and keeps them.
The $(item)Rift Bestiary$() holds every creature the rift has shown me, its lure, its traits and moves, and what mine have learned.
